parameter.fhir_comments: a parameter with no default narrows the media type: anything that is application/xml; charset=utf-8 is also application/xml. RFC 7303 section 3.2 tells consumers not to assume a default encoding for application/xml, so the bare form really is the general case - unlike text/plain, whose parameters all default (see mimetype-subsumes-default-explicit)
